lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Here is your order. One tea and two blueberry muffins.
lines.zh: 您的餐点。一杯茶和两个蓝莓松饼。

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Actually, I asked for chocolate muffins.
lines.zh: 其实我点的是巧克力松饼。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Oh no, I am so sorry. Let me fix that right away.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: It is okay. I am not in a hurry.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Thank you for being so patient. The next one is on the house.
lines.zh: 谢谢你这么有耐心。下一份我们请客。

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: That is very kind of you.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Do you need any help over there?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Yes, could you grab two chocolate muffins from the back?
lines.zh: 需要，你能去后面拿两个巧克力松饼吗？

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Coming right up. I will be quick.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: This place always makes my day better.
lines.zh: 这地方总能让我一天都好心情。
